Parent epic: https://github.com/stevehill1981/198x/issues/121

## Scope
Select one real learner journey across Foundations, machine-specific lesson, Vault/Pattern, runnable emulator and understanding check. Review navigation, mobile use, code readability, copy/paste versus active experimentation, media/graphics/audio accessibility and embedded WASM latency. Deliver a bounded improvement and measure outcomes with learners.

## Acceptance
- Cite actual pages, browsers, device sizes, tasks, measured results and known limitations.
- Identify existing issues before creating new ones; report up to five first prioritised fixes.
- Propose or deliver one bounded improvement with before/after evidence rather than a full redesign.
- Preserve site-specific identity and cross-platform accessibility.
title: [Code198x UX] Pilot an integrated learning journey from discovery to runnable exercise
